class.name: SteamWorkshopItemRef
class.brief_description: Scoped reference to one Workshop item by published file ID.

method.name: edit
method.description: Creates a branchable draft that edits this existing item. Unset fields keep their current values. Submission verifies that the item belongs to the active app.

method.name: fetch
method.description: Use [code]await item.fetch()[/code] to receive a [SteamWorkshopItemResult] for this exact item in the active app. An unavailable or removed item can report [constant ERR_FILE_NOT_FOUND].

method.name: install
method.description: Use [code]await item.install()[/code] to receive a [SteamWorkshopInstallResult]. A same-app item with a current local directory resolves immediately after identity verification. Otherwise this waits for Steam's matching download. [param high_priority] tells Steam to prioritize the transfer ahead of other downloads. An unsubscribed item may be cached temporarily. Inspect and validate the installed content before using it.

method.name: installed
method.description: Returns a current local content directory after this client verifies the item through a Workshop query or a matching install event. An unknown, pending, legacy, or out-of-date install returns [code]null[/code]. Steam can record this inspection in the signed-in player's used items.

method.name: subscribe
method.description: Use [code]await item.subscribe()[/code] to receive the [SteamWorkshopSubscriptionResult] for an explicit subscription to this app's item. The result confirms the subscription. Use [method install] to wait for a current local directory.

method.name: unsubscribe
method.description: Use [code]await item.unsubscribe()[/code] to receive the [SteamWorkshopSubscriptionResult] for removing the subscription. Steam may remove the installed files after the game closes.

method.name: vote
method.description: Use [code]await item.vote(up)[/code] to receive the [SteamWorkshopVoteResult] after Steam acknowledges this app item's upvote or downvote for the signed-in account.
